description: Explicitly excluded or paused acceptance scopes for the visible PowerPoint feature catalog. Every entry must name a reason and a source; an exclusion is a recorded decision, never a silent gap. eng/Test-FeatureAcceptanceCoverage.ps1 fails when a visible Feature ID is neither covered by an acceptance scenario nor excluded here, and when an exclusion is stale, unclassified or unexplained.
snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
